tldr: The balance sheet now caches its account totals and sync status, keyed by 2 new family timestamps that each sync updates. Pages load without waiting for syncs, and sparklines answer 304 when nothing changed.
goal: Keep the dashboard fast while accounts sync, without stale totals after a sync completes.

story.heading: Family gets 2 sync timestamps
story.body: latest_sync_activity_at changes on each sync transition. latest_sync_completed_at changes when a sync completes.

story.heading: Each sync transition now touches the family
story.body: Sync touches latest_sync_activity_at on every transition and latest_sync_completed_at on completion, for family, account and Plaid item syncs.

story.heading: BalanceSheet splits into small objects
story.body: AccountTotals, AccountGroup, NetWorthSeriesBuilder and SyncStatusMonitor replace a single large query. Sync status is read once per sync activity.

story.heading: Caches expire on the next completed sync
story.body: build_cache_key adds latest_sync_completed_at, in place of a query per key. Sparklines send an ETag, so the browser gets 304 until the next sync.

story.heading: The whole change
story.body: Sync writes 2 timestamps on Family. Insights and the sparklines read them to expire their caches.

components.summary: The dashboard, sidebar and charts read the new balance sheet groups and show a small sync indicator in place of blocking loaders.
Sparklines answer with ETag and Last-Modified and cache the series for 24 hours.
build_cache_key can expire on data updates; syncing? moves to Syncable.
Sync complete events update the desktop and mobile sidebars; chart caching moves to the family timestamps.
BalanceSheet is built from AccountTotals, groups, NetWorthSeriesBuilder and SyncStatusMonitor, with cached totals.
The balance sheet function reads the new assets and liabilities groups.
Sync transitions touch the family timestamps; Syncable answers syncing? from its visible syncs.
PlaidItem drops its own syncing? and uses the one from Syncable.
New latest_sync_activity_at and latest_sync_completed_at columns on families.

decisions.title: 2 timestamps on Family as cache keys
decisions.why: 1 touch per sync transition expires every family cache. A key no longer needs a query for the newest entry.
decisions.alternative: entries.maximum(:updated_at) in each cache key, as before.

decisions.title: Activity and completion are separate timestamps
decisions.why: Sync status changes when a sync starts or ends. Totals change only when a sync completes, so they keep their cache during a sync.
decisions.alternative: A single timestamp for every sync change.

decisions.title: Small POROs in the BalanceSheet namespace
decisions.why: The app keeps logic in models and POROs. Each object answers a single question: totals, groups, the net worth series or sync status.
decisions.alternative: A single BalanceSheet class with a single large query.

decisions.title: HTTP caching for sparklines
decisions.why: stale? with the last completed sync lets the browser reuse its copy. The server then renders nothing.
decisions.alternative: Server-side cache only, with a full render on each request.
